data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'tōrō' meaning 'a torch'. This name symbolizes the bearer of light and guidance, often associated with the Christian faith. The name Torry carries the meaning “Torch bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Torry usually hope their child will grow to embody torch bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Torry" may not have an obvious cultural impact as it's not a particularly common name in many cultures. In general, the name "Torry" may be seen as a strong, masculine name due to its origin and associations with light and guidance, making it an inspiring choice.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian faith, the name "Torry" holds the spiritual significance of being a bearer of light and guidance. It reminds us of Jesus, who is referred to as the "Light of the World," and embodies the idea of illuminating the path for others. As such, a person named Torry is encouraged to live up to this name by being a role model, a teacher, a guide, and a source of inspiration and wisdom for those around them.
